subject: File control entry
notes: kb/Work PB1097: the implementor's content rule (DOC-A.1-73: spaces removed, empty or a character below U+0020 names no file) is ONE function, FileConnector.AssociationFailure, asked by every OPEN (Associate) and by every SORT and MERGE for the sort-merge file's own ASSIGN USING (CobolSort.AssociationMade, rendered by SortEmitter.EmitAssociation before any phase). When the association cannot be made the statement is unsuccessful (12.4.5.3 GR3; 3.176): nothing is released, sequenced or returned and no USING or GIVING file is touched. Golden pb1097_sort_merge_assign_using_content: all-spaces content (SORT USING GIVING, and MERGE) and a control character (SORT with procedures) terminate the statement; valid content with surrounding spaces runs.
